lines: His clock's stopped! Nothing's pulling on the Swap-o-Tron!
Come to my lab in the Far Future! Rex gets his hands back!
Meet me at the Tomorrow Clock, {player}. Don't be long!
The old slide? Every page about it is torn out!
It just says "The Incident". And a little ghost.
Rex's Bill of Rights? Of course I'll sign!
(Dash signs with a lightning bolt.)
Being a husky made him nicer. Don't tell him.
You've got a shell too? I keep sniffing EVERYTHING.
There you are! Look up!
The stars over Observatory Hill blink like a clock.
Go look from the Observatory! There's a schematic up there too.
Take it to Zippy!
BZZZT! Oh! Hi! You found my lab!
{player}: Rex said you dropped these.
My bits! THANK you! I'm Dash, Rex's twin.
Now the cog goes... in... (CLICK.)
(The Buzz Bot zooms right out of the lab!)
NO NO NO! Catch it! Just walk into it!
Walk right into it! It's out the front!
You caught it! You're a natural!
I've got a gadget stall in the Market Square!
Here's the Star Popper's blueprint. Thanks!
Bring it to my stall. I'll build you one!
Got the blueprint? Bring it to my stall!
Your own Star Popper! {shoot} to blow bubbles, {aim} to aim.
Win races and help out to earn more blueprints!
Have a look at my gadget stall!
YOU POPPED THE GLOOP KING! I saw it all!
{player}: He was SO bouncy.
His crown's yours, champion!
The Gloop King's through the gooey gate in the west fields!
Jump his goo ring!
Keep popping him! I'll cheer!
{player}! I want to show you something.
Pip's by the portal! Go on!
Can't stop! Experiment! Bye!
Talk to Rex, he's doing a whole tour!
Follow the pink pointer on your watch!
Rook won't come for us. Maybe for you? Try a ball!
All ready! Pull the big lever. It's probably safe!
{player}: Probably?
Very probably.
Go on, ask Rex!
Whoa! {player}! I mean... hi, stranger!
{player}: Do I know you?
Not yet! Kind of. Time stuff.
I'm Dash. I'm here to fix something BIG.
Can't say! Future talk makes time ripples.
{player}: What would you want a mayor to do?
Rex? Mayor? Okay!
A bike lane round the lake!
{player}: Dash, I found this in deep water. I heard voices!
That's from our lab. From the night it happened!
Time drops things. Deep water keeps them.
Bring me every piece you find!

rotate: {player}: Another piece of that night, Dash.
I remember this. I really do.

lines: {player}: Dash, I found this funny watch.
A lost watch! Everyone who lands here brings one.
I'm collecting them!
Bring me more?
That's {watches_given} of 20!

rotate: Ooh! From a long way away. Or a long time!

lines: The portal's open! Time's all stretchy!
Out for a ride! Wind in my hat!
Do you know what snacks they have in the fu-
...Crackers. Totally normal crackers.
Sunsets here are pink and purple and sparkly!
Morning. Brain's still... loading.
Find a funny-looking watch? Bring it to me!
Look up high, and down low!
Can't sleep. Boots-and-cats, boots-and-cats!
I rode round the lake eleven times. Twelve?

rotate: Leaning on my bike is my favourite way to stand.
Psst. Want to know a future secret?

lines: Okay. In the future...
...nope! Time ripple. Sorry!
Smart! You'd be great at time travel.

rotate: Untz, untz, untz. The beat's always in my head!
